name: Dusklander
storyline: Hope wakes up with a glowing sigil on her hand and has no idea what happened, where she is or how to handle this situation. You need to gather resources, learn to combine them and figure out the rules of survival in this strange place. Each death brings you back to where you started and serves as a valuable learning experience. With time you start to notice that the fabric of this nightmare reality can be shaped by the power of your will.
summary:
Dusklander is a survival game about a goth girl trapped in a dark nightmare world.

Hope wakes up with a glowing sigil on her hand and has no idea what happened, where she is or how to handle this situation. You need to gather resources, learn to combine them and figure out the rules of survival in this strange place. Each death brings you back to where you started and serves as a valuable learning experience. With time you start to notice that the fabric of this nightmare reality can be shaped by the power of your will.
